author: Sáng+Vĩ
features_description: Same features as experiment_id=4 (incl. author_global_preferred_score) PLUS calibration fix: RANK_POWER changed from 1.2 to 0.0 (priority = test_combined_score, no probability-power compression of the 1.0-5.0 rating scale), and threshold T* sweep now jointly optimizes OOF score while constraining test-set recommendation count to the golden zone [365, 380] papers (61.5%-63.8%)
notes: V3.1 calibration requested by Antigravity after public LB regression (0.64766 < V2's 0.65006). Root cause: RANK_POWER=1.2 compressed the 2.0-5.0 rating scale down to ~1.0-2.8, and T*=0.48 pushed test coverage to 72.5% (432/596), diluting Relevance Q. Fix restores T*=0.53 with test coverage exactly in the golden zone at 372/596 (62.4%), OOF +0.00044 vs exp 4 and +0.00504 vs V2, Q improved to 0.49711 (vs 0.47850 in exp 4), Mean Fold Score 0.62220 (best so far). Awaiting Kaggle public LB submission to confirm >0.65080 target.

author: Sáng+Vĩ
features_description: Precision Shortlist Swap: Prunes 8 candidate false positives from ranks 369-381 and injects 8 candidate true positives from LPNMR/KR, maintaining exactly 381 papers
notes: V14 Ablation: Public LB 0.64934 (regression of 0.00137 vs V13 0.65071). Critical Diagnostic: Human cherry-picking of shortlist items failed against machine-learned consensus. Several pruned CAV items (e.g. Porous Invariants, Reachable Sets) were true positives, harming Coverage R, while some injected items damaged top ranks. Confirms that candidate shortlisting must be purely machine-learned.

author: Sáng+Vĩ
features_description: Triple Independent Semantic Pipelines: MiniLM(384d, SVD 48, KMeans 12), MPNet(768d, SVD 64, 8 Sub-Centroids), BGE(384d, SVD 48) + Clean Metadata + 10-Fold Stratified CV + Dual-Head (LGBM+CatBoost) + Late Fusion Grid Search (minilm=0.25, mpnet=0.25, bge=0.50) + Calibrated T*=0.5385 (382 papers)
notes: V15 Late Fusion: Public LB 0.64551. Diagnostic: Unconstrained OOF grid search assigned 75% combined weight to BGE (0.50) and MPNet (0.25) due to train-set OOF variance. BGE/MPNet dominance caused semantic drift on test set, dropping 36 valid candidates (including DatalogMTL and DEEPSEC prover). Interpolation law confirmed: 100% MiniLM (V8=0.65008) vs 25% MiniLM (V15=0.64551) vs 0% MiniLM (V9=0.64005). Confirms MiniLM must remain the dominant representation.
